title: Voip.NET — queues
description: Queue traffic from the calls Voip.NET's call centre stores (voipnet_calls). Written for a PostgreSQL datasource; enqueued_at is epoch milliseconds.

list.name: queue
list.label: Queue
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT queue FROM voipnet_calls ORDER BY queue

panels.title: Calls per interval
panels.description: Offered, answered and abandoned, grouped by the dashboard's interval.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeGroupAlias(to_timestamp(enqueued_at / 1000), $__interval),
  COUNT(*) AS offered,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome = 'Answered') AS answered,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome = 'Abandoned') AS abandoned,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome = 'Overflowed') AS overflowed
FROM voipnet_calls
WHERE $__unixEpochFilter(enqueued_at / 1000)
  AND queue IN ($queue)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Service level
panels.description: Share of answered calls picked up within the answer target.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  COALESCE(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE waited_ms <= $target_seconds * 1000)::float / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 0) AS service_level
FROM voipnet_calls
WHERE $__unixEpochFilter(enqueued_at / 1000)
  AND queue IN ($queue)
  AND outcome = 'Answered'

panels.title: Abandon rate
panels.description: Callers who hung up while waiting, as a share of everything offered.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  COALESCE(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome = 'Abandoned')::float / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 0) AS abandon_rate
FROM voipnet_calls
WHERE $__unixEpochFilter(enqueued_at / 1000)
  AND queue IN ($queue)

panels.title: Waiting and talking
panels.description: Mean wait of answered calls, the longest wait anyone had, and mean talk time.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeGroupAlias(to_timestamp(enqueued_at / 1000), $__interval),
  AVG(waited_ms) FILTER (WHERE outcome = 'Answered') / 1000 AS average_wait,
  MAX(waited_ms) / 1000 AS longest_wait,
  AVG(talked_ms) FILTER (WHERE outcome = 'Answered') / 1000 AS average_talk
FROM voipnet_calls
WHERE $__unixEpochFilter(enqueued_at / 1000)
  AND queue IN ($queue)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT outcome, COUNT(*) AS calls
FROM voipnet_calls
WHERE $__unixEpochFilter(enqueued_at / 1000)
  AND queue IN ($queue)
GROUP BY outcome
ORDER BY calls DESC

panels.title: Agents
panels.description: Who answered how much, and how long they spent talking.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  agent_id,
  COUNT(*) AS calls,
  SUM(talked_ms) / 1000 AS talk_time,
  AVG(talked_ms) / 1000 AS average_talk
FROM voipnet_calls
WHERE $__unixEpochFilter(enqueued_at / 1000)
  AND queue IN ($queue)
  AND agent_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY agent_id
ORDER BY calls DESC

panels.title: Calls out of hours
panels.description: Callers who reached a queue while it was closed (QueueOutcome.Closed), which is demand a schedule turned away.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeGroupAlias(to_timestamp(enqueued_at / 1000), $__interval),
  queue,
  COUNT(*) AS closed
FROM voipnet_calls
WHERE $__unixEpochFilter(enqueued_at / 1000)
  AND queue IN ($queue)
  AND outcome = 'Closed'
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1
